A practical handover checklist

Details
By Jesus Hessel
Jesus Hessel
Category: Practical guides
14 September 2021
Hits: 32

A website handover should give the owner confidence to make everyday changes. Access credentials alone do not explain how the site is organised.

Putting it into practice

Walk through changing a service, replacing a photograph and publishing a post. Record the support contact and recovery process, and confirm that the owner can complete those tasks.
